description:
Noba Animal Co. is a Canadian company dedicated to enhancing the well-being of cats by offering high-quality, innovative products that blend functionality with modern design. With over 20 years of family-driven passion, Noba aims to strengthen the bond between cat owners and their feline companions.

Noba Animal


Product Description:

Noba's product line includes:

  • Cat Furniture: Stylish and functional pieces such as scratching posts, cat trees, condos, hideouts, and wall-mounted furniture, all crafted from sturdy Canadian wood.

    Noba Animal


  • Cat Litter: Premium options like Noba Science, which utilizes probiotic technology for odor control, and Canada Litter™, made from pure sodium bentonite for superior clumping and absorption.

    Noba Animal
    Noba Animal


  • Catnip Products: Natural stimulants like Noba Mist Catnip Spray, made from 100% organic Nepeta Cataria, to encourage play and relaxation.

    Noba Animal


Unique Selling Point (USP):

Noba distinguishes itself by combining high-quality materials, such as Canadian wood and organic catnip, with innovative designs that cater to cats' natural behaviors. Their products are not only functional but also aesthetically pleasing, seamlessly integrating into modern homes. Additionally, Noba emphasizes sustainability and eco-friendly practices in their manufacturing processes.

Noba Animal Co. Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions

Welcome to Noba Animal Co.! Thank you for joining our Affiliate Program.

The following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and as an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use products or services from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, affiliates agree to use the Program as specified in, and be bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approval or Rejection of Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program registration at our sole discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your registration.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupons

Affiliate links are automatically generated, and affiliates may also create links for specific products or collections. If a customer clicks on multiple referral links, the most recent click will be credited.

Affiliates may be assigned a coupon code with details outlined in their Dashboard. If a customer uses both an affiliate link and a coupon code, the affiliate will not receive a double commission. Affiliates not assigned a branded coupon are not authorized to promote or use it.

Affiliates may promote the merchant’s website online (e.g., Facebook, Instagram) or through offline channels such as classified ads, magazines, or newspapers.

3. Commissions and Payments

Affiliates earn a commission based on the value of orders placed through their referral link or assigned coupon code, excluding additional fees (e.g., taxes, shipping).

To receive payment, affiliates must provide their payment details in the Settings tab. Payment schedules will be detailed in the Affiliate Guide.

Payments are issued only for successfully completed transactions. Any orders resulting in chargebacks or refunds will not qualify for commissions.

4. Marketing Tools

We provide promotional materials such as banners, logos, or specific collection promotions via the Marketing Tools tab. Affiliates can download these resources or embed them using provided HTML codes to share on their channels.

5. Network Referrals

If enabled, affiliates may recruit others to join the program as downline affiliates. Upline affiliates will earn a network commission for orders brought in by their downline affiliates, based on merchant settings.

Affiliates can invite others using their unique network link. Anyone who registers through this link will become their downline affiliate.

6. Cookie Tracking

Our program uses cookies to track customer activity through affiliate links. If cookies are disabled or cleared, tracking will not be possible, and commissions cannot be earned.

Cookie tracking duration (e.g., 30 days) is specified during registration. Any purchases made within this period will automatically credit the affiliate, even if the customer does not re-click the affiliate link.

7. Account Inactivity and Program Termination

We reserve the right to terminate any affiliate agreement or the entire program at any time without prior notice or delay.

Affiliate accounts that remain inactive for 3 months or more will be deleted automatically.

8. Removal from the Referral Program

Affiliates wishing to leave the program may contact affiliates@nobaanimal.com for removal.

Final Note

Thank you for taking the time to read this document. We’re excited to have you on board and look forward to working together! For any questions, feel free to email us at affiliates@nobaanimal.com.
